name: com.codinzy/trial-booking
title: Codinzy free trial class booking
description: Find free times and book a free trial of Codinzy's live online AI and coding classes for kids 5-17.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: Codinzy's public course catalogue for kids and teens aged 5-17 (grades 1-12): each course's name, ages, grades, number of lessons, a short description and its page, the coding camps, and the website's prices per class (Plus, Pro, Prime, with the 25% scholarship). Read only. Use it to suggest a course; then help the parent book a free trial class with get_free_trial_times.

tools.name: get_free_trial_times
tools.description: The free trial class times a Codinzy tutor has for a child, in the family's time zone: the same times the booking page offers that child. Needs the child's school grade (1-12) and the country the family lives in. Each time has a `slot_token` (valid 6 hours): when the parent picks a time, pass it to create_booking_link (the parent books on the page) or, with the parent's go-ahead, to request_trial_booking. Read only: nothing is booked or held, and times can fill up.

country.description: Where the family lives: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (BD, US, GB, IN, AE, ...) or the country name
country.title: Country

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the times, e.g. Asia/Dhaka (default: the country's main zone)
timezone.title: Timezone

utm_source.description: Who is asking, kept in the links for attribution, e.g. chatgpt.com, claude.ai
utm_source.title: Utm Source

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: A link the PARENT opens to book the free trial class: the Codinzy booking page with the chosen time selected (pass the `slot` from get_free_trial_times) and, if given, their phone number filled in. This tool books NOTHING and holds nothing: tell the parent to open the link, check the details and press "Book my free class". Without a phone number the page asks for it first, then shows the time. language "bn" gives the Bangla booking page for a Bangla-speaking parent.

phone.description: Parent's mobile number in E.164, e.g. +8801712345678 (optional; used for the class link on WhatsApp)
phone.title: Phone

timezone.description: IANA time zone the parent uses (optional; the booking page shows times in it)
timezone.title: Timezone

slot.description: The `slot_token` of the time the parent picked (from get_free_trial_times)
slot.title: Slot

country.description: ISO code or name of the country the family lives in (optional)
country.title: Country

language.description: The booking page language: en (default) or bn for the Bangla booking page
language.title: Language

tools.name: request_trial_booking
tools.description: Request a FREE Codinzy trial class for a parent's child at a time from `get_free_trial_times`. Use it only after the parent chose the time and agreed. Nothing is booked yet: the time is held for about 30 minutes and the parent confirms from their own WhatsApp (a Confirm button in a WhatsApp message, or the `confirm_url` you show them, where they enter a code we send to their WhatsApp). Inputs: `phone` (the parent's WhatsApp number in E.164, e.g. +8801712345678), `grade` (1-12), `timezone` (IANA, e.g. Asia/Dhaka), `slot_token` (from the free times), optional `child_name`. Returns `request_id`, `status` ("pending"), `expires_at` and `confirmation` (`channel` "whatsapp" or "link" with `confirm_url`): tell the parent what to do, then poll `get_trial_booking_request` until "confirmed", "expired" or "cancelled". On a refusal, tell the parent the `error` sentence; for `slot_unavailable` or `slot_taken` offer new times. Never ask for passwords, emails or payment details.

phone.description: The parent's WhatsApp number in E.164, e.g. +8801712345678
phone.title: Phone

timezone.description: The parent's IANA time zone, e.g. Asia/Dhaka
timezone.title: Timezone

slot_token.description: The slot_token of the time the parent chose (from get_free_trial_times)
slot_token.title: Slot Token

start_time.description: ISO 8601 start with offset, only when there is no slot_token
start_time.title: Start Time

agent_name.description: Shown to the parent, e.g. ChatGPT
agent_name.title: Agent Name

tools.name: get_trial_booking_request
tools.description: The status of a request made with request_trial_booking: "pending" (waiting for the parent to confirm on WhatsApp), "confirmed" (booked), "expired" or "cancelled". Poll at most every 30 seconds. Read only.

tools.name: cancel_trial_booking_request
tools.description: Release a PENDING request made with request_trial_booking (for example the parent wants another time). A confirmed class is not cancelled here: the parent manages it from their trial dashboard.
